subject: Passing dataframe to another tab on Action Button Click

messages.author: 12ba4fcf8526f1d6
messages.subject: Passing dataframe to another tab on Action Button Click
parts:
On ActionButton, data frame is created. I have to use that data frame in the new tab . I have two problems .

1)  I am not able to change tabselection using updateTabsetPanel.

2) When I change the tab manually, I lost the dataframe created in the ActionButton. I use this dataframe for dynamicUI in the new sidebar of tab2. Where it says the dataframe object is not found.

ActionButton Code:

server.R:

#Control for Tab2

output$segment <- renderUI({
      
      if (is.null(x1)) { return() }
      if (identical(x1, '') || identical(x1,data.frame()) || is.null(x1) ) return(NULL)
      
      # Variable selection:  Segment for Plot
      selectInput("varSegment", "Choose Segment", unique(x1[,varColSegment]), multiple = FALSE,selected=isolate(input$varSegment) )
    })

observe({
 isolate({
      x1<-inititate()
    if(!is.null(x1))
    {
      
      updateTabsetPanel(session, "tabForecast", "Best Model Forecast")
    }


})

})

ui.R:

tabPanel(title="Best Model Forecast",
               h4(textOutput("caption2")),
               showOutput("plotx", "Morris"),value=2)


Dynamic UI:

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Passing dataframe to another tab on Action Button Click
parts: x1, varColCountry, and valColSegment should all be reactive expressions, not variables that are written in an observer. In a reactive expression you can still use the actionButton/isolate pattern in the same way, to defer calculation until after click (you'll just have these reactive expressions return NULL if the actionButton value is 0, and check for NULL wherever these expressions are used).
